PR #147 repair review: pass-with-notes at 5c8ff97a8cb021e4f862afdde137713c50658c05, scoped to the complete seven-file delta from 29488ca. Request 325693b633ea1aca-0000000000000113 through reviewer/147.

F001 closed: send/global value-option tables are held equal to clap, with a growth negative. The scanner consumes separate/equals values and -- boundaries; original body/from/msg-id orders and opaque role-looking msg-id are actual full-shim CI controls.

F002 closed: only a tmux pane enables fast real sends; inherited PIJ_SESSION_ID never enables paneless forwarding. Positional-role and --to inherited-ID forms stay routed, preserving observed-host registration and its ID override. Existing admission bridge module passes 67 Node tests. Do not equate this non-forwarding proof with newly supporting every native-only flag in the old HTTP parser.

N001 closed: the selector finds the verb beyond --json and global value options, without changing argv passed to pij-rs. PATH selection now skips relative entries, and native acting-seat resolution carries full caller_context; source and CI cover those coupled changes, separate security grading retained.

Exact-head CI run 42197742059: all four jobs green, 1,978 Rust passed/five skipped; JUnit confirms three clap/six shim tests. Node 22 logs show 2,198 passed/six skipped, including generation-router.test.ts's 67. A bounded pure-production-selector oracle ran nice -n 19 taskpolicy -b for uncovered terminator/help-data cases: 22 passed. No tsx/daemon/Rust build or live sender test, no dependency changes.
